title: Good: TypeFilter::allows _ arm comment guards new-type additions
description: The comment above the _ => false arm in TypeFilter::allows explicitly warns that any contributor adding a new broadcast type MUST add a corresponding match arm or events will be silently dropped for filtered clients. This is correct: TypeFilter::parse() rejects unknown names at the query layer, so the _ arm is only reachable via internal broadcast events. Without this comment, a contributor adding a new JMAP type could introduce a silent data-loss bug. The comment is load-bearing documentation.
